sources.title: Nemotron - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Nemotron is a family of artificial intelligence models developed by Nvidia. It includes large language models and multimodal models intended for reasoning, computer programming, information retrieval and agentic AI applications. Nvidia has released open model weights, training data, software and training methods for parts of the family. [2][3]
